[[Nakhon Pathom FC|Nakhon Pathom]] '''2-5''' [[BG Pathum United F.C.|Bangkok Glass]] '''(7)''' | total goals = | average goals = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest losses = | highest attendance = [[Muangthong United F.C.|Muangthong United]] 1–1 [[Chonburi F.C.|Chonburi]] (16,608) (4 October 2009) | lowest attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2008 Thailand Premier League|2008]] | nextseason = [[2010 Thai Premier League|2010]] }} The Thai Premier League 2009 was the thirteenth season of the Premier League since its establishment in 1996. A total of 16 teams competed in the league, with [[PEA FC]] as the defending champions. '''Muang Thong United''' took the league championship with two games remaining, the first ever team to win the championship in their debut appearance in the top flight. Nakhon Pathom, Sriracha and Chula United were relegated to the 1st Division. ==Rules== *Teams play each other twice on a home and away basis *3 Points for a win *1 Points for a draw *At beginning of the season the league winner plays the FA Cup winner in the [[Kor Royal Cup]] *Loser qualifies for [[Asian Champions League]] Qualification Round *Teams finishing on same points at the end of the season use toe-to-toe record to determine finishing position. *Bottom 10 teams are relegated to [[Thai Division 1 League]] ==Member clubs and locations== {{location map+ |Thailand |float=right |width=350 |caption=Locations of the 2009 Thai Premier League teams |places= {{location map~ |Thailand |marksize=7|lat=14.349943 |long= 100.597258 |label_size=80|label= [[Provincial Electricity Authority FC|PEA]]|position=right|mark=Red pog.svg}} {{location map~ |Thailand|marksize=7 |lat=13.163489|long=100.940406 |label_size=80|label= [[Chonburi F.C.|Chonburi]]|position=right|mark=Red pog.svg}} {{location map~ |Thailand|marksize=7 |lat=14.049855 |long=99.502743 |label_size=80|label= [[TOT FC|TOT]] |position=left|mark=Red pog.svg}} {{location map~ |Thailand|marksize=7 |lat=13.414193 |long=99.999613 |label_size=80|label= [[Samut Songkhram F.C.|Samut Songkhram]]|position=left|mark=Red pog.svg}} {{location map~ |Thailand|marksize=7 |lat=12.924339 |long=100.937163|label_size=80|label= [[Pattaya United F.C. (2008)|Pattaya United]] at the end of the [[Thai Premier League 2008]] season. Coke Bangpra therefore withdrew from the Thai football league system and Pattaya would start their life in the very top division. *[[Provincial Electricity Authority FC|Provincial Electricity Authority]] were drawn against [[Singapore Armed Forces Football Club|Singapore Armed Forces]] of [[Singapore]] in the opening game of the [[AFC Champions League 2009]] and were defeated 4-1 after extra time. *On December 30, 2008, Thailand confirmed that Denmark, North Korea and Lebanon would play in the [[2009 King's Cup]] tournament.
